source_title: Experimental Machines — Founding Governance Design Draft v0.1 (Sep 26, 2026)

status.src: p.1: “This is a design proposal for three founders to argue with, not a legal document.”

founders.src: p.2: “three founding members, three unpaid trustees, and three officers”

officers.src: p.51: “GDR-003 Initial Officers: President Alpha, Treasurer John, Corporate Secretary Arjhine”

unpaid_period.src: p.25: “Founders serve unpaid for about a year.”

open.src: p.6: “Three are OPEN and three DEFERRED”

deferred.src: p.6: “Three are OPEN and three DEFERRED”

for_review.src: p.51: “Eight decided, twenty-seven for review (including three open), three deferred.”

decisions_total.src: p.6 (the four counts above); the record's ids run GDR-001 to GDR-038 (p.11)

two_thirds_of_three.src: p.11: “With three members, "2/3 of all members" means two of three”

quorum.src: p.25: “With one trustee recused, two remain: exactly a quorum. Both must vote yes.”

mission_notice_days.src: p.15: “circulated to all members at least 30 days before the first vote”

unanimity_alt_members.src: p.15: “require unanimity for purpose changes only while there are fewer than five members”

mission_gap_days.src: p.15: “Approval by 2/3 of all members at two meetings held at least 60 days apart.”

intervention_grounds.src: p.18: “When the Board may intervene Only on these grounds, and only as far as the ground requires”
intervention_grounds.derived: the nine row heads of the table that follows the quote

intervention_rules.src: p.19: “Every intervention is written, gives reasons, names the ground, and is time-limited.”

disinterested_needed.src: p.25: “until the Board has at least two trustees with no interest in them”

removal_response_days.src: p.22: “At least 30 days to respond in writing and at a hearing.”

not_causes.src: p.22: “Not a cause: scientific disagreement, disagreement about research direction, voting against the majority, publishing a result others dislike, or criticizing the organization in good faith.”

sponsor_review_days.src: p.30: “limited to removing its own confidential information: recommend up to 30 days”

patent_delay_days.src: p.31: “A reasonable delay for patent filing is allowed: recommend up to 90 days.”

ip_program_triggers.src: p.28: “Category B is triggered only by the six listed connections.”

broaden_members.src: p.45: “admit at least two non-founder members”
